text:
ana: quick heads-up — reproduced an edge where a streaming session that invokes a toolcall then gets client-truncated ends up with two confirmed ledger rows after reconnect. staging repro attached.

mike: can you paste the sanitized trace + ledger rows?

ana: pasted: ```STREAM_START id=tx-901 model=gpt-lite seq=0
STREAM_CHUNK seq=1 tokens=28 prefix=\"Item\"
TOOLCALL start id=tc-3
STREAM_TRUNCATE reason=client_disconnect
LEDGER provisional tokens=28 session=tx-901 note=partial_stream
RECONNECT via router=ap-2 session=tx-901-1
STREAM_CHUNK seq=1 tokens=28 prefix=\"Item\"
LEDGER confirmed tokens=28 session=tx-901-1 note=resume_confirm```

lee: so provisional 28 then confirmed 28 — invoice shows both. router that handled resume probably didn't see provisional tombstone.

toni: we have three axes to fix: (1) plumbing an opaque continuity_token on provisional writes and forward it on resume so confirm can attach by token; (2) add short prefix_fingerprint (8b) to stream chunks for fuzzy-match fallback; (3) console visibility for provisional rows.

mike: continuity_token approach looks safest. Implementation: write continuity_token into provisional table with TTL (5m). On resume, router sends header X-Continuity-Token. Ledger confirm tries: SELECT FOR UPDATE provisional WHERE continuity_token = X; if present and not attached -> attach and mark tombstone. If absent, fallback to fuzzy-match.

ana: fuzzy-match strictness: require prefix_fingerprint equality and confirmed_tokens <= provisional_tokens * 1.05. Log model/version mismatch as anomaly.

lee: quota nuance: provisional currently decrements quota immediately. If we attach later, we must not double-charge quota. Short-term: keep existing quota behavior but ensure attach path does not decrement again. Long-term: discuss soft_quota vs hard_quota model with billing.

mike: telemetry: emit provisional.orphan.count, provisional.attach.rate, unmatched_confirm.count, continuity_token_seen.rate. Add dashboard: provisional vs confirmed drift and top affected customers.

toni: console: add "Billing (Preview)" toggle that shows reconciled totals (provisional-aware) for support-only; add per-session pill states (provisional/attached/confirmed) and link to trace.

billing-bot: ticket BILL-2701 created "Provisional attach + continuity token" assigned: billing, eng-platform, console.

deploy-bot: feature-flag rollout scheduled: continuity-token-attach -> 2% canary -> 2024-08-05T12:00:00Z.

mike: I'll PR DB schema + idempotent attach txn. lee will add prefix_fingerprint to streaming proto. toni will prototype console panel. ana will own telemetry + runbook.

ana: one more: protect against concurrent confirms attaching to same provisional — use DB CAS or transactional tombstone. add unit tests simulating cross-router resume.

lee: OK. if metrics look good after canary, we'll ramp. thanks all.
